newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain wine producer CVNE plans public offer-CNMV.
newsitem.headline: Spain wine producer CVNE plans public offer-CNMV.

text.p: Spanish wine producer Compania Vinicola del Norte de Espana (CVNE) is planning a public offering and a capital rise, Spanish stock market commission CNMV said on Wednesday.
"CVNE communicates that it has the intention of taking the necessary legal steps for a public share offering and a capital rise, offering the subscription rights publicly," CVNE told the CNMV.
The group said it was confident of winning authorisation for its shares to trade in Madrid and in Bilbao.
The group, which produces the brands CVNE, Imperial and Vina Real from the heart of Spain's Rioja wine region, was founded in 1879 by the grandfather of the current chairman.
